annotations.title: Add or update products in a Reddit catalog

description: Add products to a Reddit catalog, or update them — re-sending an id you already sent UPDATES that product, it never duplicates it. Up to 1,000 per call. Fields are Reddit’s own snake_case product attributes: id (your SKU, required), title, description, price as "<amount> <ISO currency>" e.g. "19.99 USD", link, image_link, availability (IN_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK, PREORDER, BACKORDER), brand, sale_price, additional_image_links, product type, Google product category, gtin, mpn, condition, color, size, gender, age_group, item_group_id, custom_label_0…4 and the rest of Reddit’s list. Reddit answers per product — CREATED, UPDATED, UNCHANGED or INVALID with the exact field and issue code — and that answer is what is reported. New products go through Reddit’s review before they can serve. Spends nothing.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

catalogId.description: catalog to add or update products in

products.description: each {id, title, price:"19.99 USD", link, image_link, availability, …}
